definitions: An act of running somewhere suddenly and quickly.
A small amount of something, especially a liquid food ingredient, added to something else.
A horizontal stroke, longer than a hyphen, used in punctuation.
A short, sharp sound or signal in Morse code.
A sudden, vigorous attack or charge.
examples: She made a dash for the door.
The signal was a series of dashes and dots.
The cavalry made a dash at the enemy.
